definitions.full: H2301. Chadad חֲדַד proper name, masculine (on this and following compare Palmyrene proper name חדודן Vog No. 96 , Sabean חדד Hal 27 ); — a son of Ishmael Gen 25:15 (compare Baer's n.; van d. H. חֲדַר ) ᵐ5 Ξοδδαν , ᵐ5 L Ξοδδαδ ; = 1Chr 1:30 ᵐ5 Ξονδαν , A Ξοδδαδ , ᵐ5 L Αδαδ .
